Name: 2 metre temperature
Definition: Monthly mean air temperature 2 m above the surface
Notes: Checked against a file downloaded from the CDS: variable `t2m` with `units` attribute `K`.

Name: Total precipitation
Definition: Monthly mean of the daily total precipitation (rain and snow) reaching the surface
Notes: Checked against a file downloaded from the CDS: variable `tp` with `units` attribute `m`. The monthly-means product reports a mean daily accumulation, so the value is a depth per day.

Name: Surface net short-wave (solar) radiation
Definition: Monthly mean of the daily net short-wave radiation at the surface (incoming minus reflected)
Notes: Checked against a file downloaded from the CDS: variable `ssr` with `units` attribute `J m**-2`. The monthly-means product reports a mean daily accumulation, so the value is an energy per area per day. Net rather than incident: WorldClim's `srad` is the incident flux.

Name: Volumetric soil water layer 1
Definition: Monthly mean volume of water per volume of soil in the top layer
Notes: Checked against a file downloaded from the CDS: variable `swvl1` with `units` attribute `m**3 m**-3`. Read as the depth of water over the cell, the fraction times the 7 cm layer.
